Quickly turns into a rage game. Gym sucks. Second fight heals for more damage than you can possibly do, teleports, and does 1/3 of your health per hit, unwinnable after multiple tries without getting extremely lucky. You have no control other than purchasing and ordering skills. Boring and annoying. Packages suck. Is there even a point to the timer thing? And there's like one package per section? Does delivering them actually do anything? I get enough credits without doing any of the objectives here, including completely skipping all fights, to buy whatever upgrades I could want, but I just skip them because there's no need for them. Getting run over by cars is dumb and annoying, especially when you just bounce on them while they drive down the road. Yay, thanks for making me have to wait longer to play the game. Ammo for skills is dumb. Especially without any way to select which skill you're using. When they run out, you don't get any replacement (for staple gun, let me pistol whip with it, at least. Paper airplane can do a slash attack, no damage but bleeds, idfk but good lord....) I get the physics deal, it adds to the game, but fix it so characters don't get stuck in doors/vents/windows or take it out.... I got stuck in an area because an enemy got stuck in an elevated window. They couldn't move and I couldn't attack, so I had to quit. Hopefully all of this is addressed - it's in early access so the Devs're still working out at least some things....

While this is a great game for 7 dollars, the fact of the matter is that this game tries to be an infinite replayable roguelite, but in reality it's a game someone will pick up, finish all the content, then never touch again. This game was certainly fun with friends, however there are plenty of other roguelite games that are replayable that you can get for the same price on sale. Maybe I'm crazy, but this is not a game one can find themselves playing for more than 12 hours.

Both Company History Month and Foreign Manufacturing share the same problem: they're far too structured and have little replay value Foreign Manufacturing especially, its the same every time, no alternate areas, no new enemies, no different landmarks, same bosses, and the only random part being the weapon choices and upgrades. by comparison, the 3 previous modes are all replay value focused, both with unlocks that add more stuff and also having a different feel between runs. i can't see myself ever replaying Foreign Manufacturing after finishing it because i know the run will go the exact same way as the previous one played.
